# Brat Generator

> Brat Generator is a free browser-based creative tool for making Brat-inspired text graphics, album-cover-style images, memes, social graphics, and animated videos without requiring an account.

Canonical site: https://bratgeneratorpro.net/

Important notes:
- Brat Generator is an independent fan-made project and is not affiliated with Charli XCX, Atlantic Records, or Warner Music.
- The website's main public content is the canonical pages linked below. Standalone embed HTML files are implementation details, not separate editorial pages.
- The image generator renders previews and downloadable output in the user's browser. The site includes adjustable colours, text size, letter spacing, blur, export dimensions, and PNG/JPG/WebP output.
- The video generator provides a browser-based Brat-inspired video workflow with text, audio, preview, FPS, and export controls.
- The default Brat Green preset uses #8ACE00 as a practical digital approximation; appearance can vary by display.
- For legal or commercial-use questions, use the Terms & Disclaimer page rather than inferring permission from the existence of the tool.

## Tools

- [Brat Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/): Main free Brat-inspired text, album-cover, meme, and social-graphic generator with live preview and browser-based downloads.
- [Brat Video Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/video-generator/): Browser-based tool for creating animated Brat-inspired videos with custom text, audio, preview, FPS, and output controls.

## Guides

- [How to Use Brat Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/how-to-use/): Step-by-step instructions covering text entry, colours, blur, spacing, canvas sizes, preview, and download.
- [Brat Generator Features](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/features/): Detailed overview of live preview, colour presets, typography controls, export sizes, formats, privacy-related behaviour, and tool limitations.
- [Brat Styles](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-styles/): Guide to Brat Green, black, white, pink, blue, and custom colour styles, including typography and blur guidance.

## Blog

- [Brat Generator Guides](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/): Hub for practical tutorials and troubleshooting content.
- [How to Make a Brat Album Cover Free](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/how-to-make-a-brat-album-cover-free/): Four-step album-cover guide covering colour, condensed typography, controlled blur, canvas sizes, and browser export.
- [Brat Generator Not Working?](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/brat-generator-not-working/): Troubleshooting guide for common browser, loading, text, preview, and download issues.
